name: restart_audio_dma_channels
description: Copies stored pointers and lengths for the four audio channels into the custom chip registers, pausing briefly between steps and setting the DMA enable bit. It then advances a step counter in the structure and wraps a sequence index against a limit taken from a second structure.

name: compare_masked_value_against_target
description: Masks a 16-bit field down to its low 12 bits and copies the result to a second field. It compares that value with a target field, clearing the result on an exact match and setting a flag when the value is lower.

name: clear_structure_word_field
description: Sets one 16-bit field of a structure to zero and returns. It performs no other work.

name: step_value_toward_target
description: Moves a 16-bit position toward a stored target by a step size held in a byte field, adding or subtracting according to a direction flag. It snaps to the target and clears it on arrival, then copies the position to an output field.

name: subtract_step_from_position
description: Subtracts a step value passed in a data register from a 16-bit position. When the result reaches a stored target it snaps to that target and clears it, and the position is copied to an output field.

name: advance_table_driven_offset
description: Looks up a scale value in a global table using bits of a phase byte, multiplies it by the low nibble of a rate byte, and adds the signed result to a position. The sum goes to an output field, and the phase advances by the high nibble of the rate byte.

name: subtract_and_advance_phase
description: Subtracts one input value from another and stores the difference in a global variable. It then advances a phase byte in the structure by an amount taken from the high nibble of a neighbouring byte.

name: copy_position_to_output
description: Copies a 16-bit position field from the object into a field of the output structure. Nothing else is changed.

name: dispatch_effect_command_nibble
description: Decodes the low nibble of a command word and applies the matching effect: a table search and lookup, a fixed-step adjustment, a clamped increment or decrement, a step toward a target, or a table-scaled offset. It writes the resulting position and level values to output fields and returns a status value.

name: adjust_level_counter_clamped
description: Adds the high nibble or subtracts the low nibble of a parameter byte from a counter field, clamping the counter between zero and 64. The counter is copied to an output field.

name: decrement_counter_clamped_zero
description: Subtracts the low nibble of a parameter byte from a 16-bit counter, clamps the counter at zero, and copies it to an output field.

name: decrement_position_clamp_minimum
description: Subtracts a byte parameter from a 16-bit position. If the low 12 bits fall below a fixed minimum they are reset to that minimum, and the low 12 bits are copied to an output field.

name: increment_position_clamp_maximum
description: Adds a byte parameter to a 16-bit position. If the low 12 bits reach a fixed maximum they are set to that maximum, and the low 12 bits are copied to an output field.

name: apply_control_nibble_command
description: Reads the low nibble of a command word and performs one of a few actions: it returns for one value, toggles a flag byte for another, loads a counter from the parameter, clamps a level to 64 and copies it out, or resets a sub-counter. Other nibble values do nothing.

name: toggle_flag_byte
description: Inverts every bit of one flag byte in the structure. It is a single read-modify-write with no other effect.

name: load_counter_and_toggle_flag
description: Stores the parameter byte minus one into a counter byte and inverts a flag byte in the same structure.

name: clamp_parameter_to_maximum
description: Clamps a parameter byte to a maximum of 64 and copies the result to an output field.

name: load_counter_from_parameter_bits
description: Takes the low five bits of a parameter byte and, when they are nonzero, resets one counter byte to zero and stores those bits in a second counter byte.

name: toggle_indexed_word_periodically
description: Counts ticks while an enable word is nonzero and, on every fifth tick, flips one of several fixed 16-bit words between two constant values. The word is chosen by an index field, with a default location for index values that are not listed.

name: toggle_fixed_word_value
description: Flips one fixed 16-bit memory word between two constant values.

name: toggle_fixed_word_value
description: Flips one fixed 16-bit memory word between two constant values.

name: toggle_fixed_word_value
description: Flips one fixed 16-bit memory word between two constant values.

name: toggle_fixed_word_value
description: Flips one fixed 16-bit memory word between two constant values.

name: write_fixed_word_through_pointer
description: Writes one fixed 16-bit constant through the pointer held in an address register. It is a single store with no test.

name: write_fixed_word_through_pointer
description: Writes a different fixed 16-bit constant through the pointer held in an address register. It is a single store with no test.

name: xor_adjacent_field_bits
description: Returns the exclusive-or of bit eight and bit nine of a 16-bit field from a structure, placed at bit nine of the result. It is a pure computation that writes nothing.

name: apply_directional_movement_step
description: Moves an object by adding or subtracting a fixed 32-bit step to several position fields, choosing the direction from input values and state flags. Some branches are cut off in the stored listing, so only the visible movement cases are described.

name: update_grid_cell_state
description: Clears two counters and reads one 16-bit cell from a global grid at the object's position. Depending on the cell value it sets trigger flags, counts down a delay before advancing the cell through a range of values, or sets a flag for two marker values.

name: consume_marker_cell_accumulate
description: Checks a grid cell at a fixed offset from the object for one special value. When it matches, the cell is cleared, and if a counter is nonzero it is decremented and 100 is added to a 32-bit accumulator.

name: set_flag_if_marker_cell
description: Clears a flag, then sets it when the grid cell at a fixed offset from the object holds one of two marker values.

name: check_cell_and_entry_hits
description: Checks the grid cell under the object's position for one marker value and, if found, clears it or decrements a counter, sets state flags and adds 100 to a 32-bit accumulator. Otherwise it tests five active table entries for overlap with the position and, on overlap, sets the same flags, adds 100 and advances that entry's progress counter.

name: resolve_entry_overlap_events
description: Tests five active entries for overlap with the object's position. An ordinary overlap decrements a counter and returns, while overlap with a type-three entry deactivates it and adds 500 to a 32-bit accumulator.

name: dispatch_event_code_actions
description: When an enabled flag and an input word are both set, dispatches on an event code to one of several actions. The actions add 100, 500 or 1000 to a 32-bit accumulator, set or decrement counters to constant values, or step through a 15-entry sequence table to choose the next action.

name: nudge_position_on_flag_clear
description: Shifts the object's position fields by a fixed step when a trigger flag has just been cleared or two flags are both zero. It then calls the next routine in the sequence.

name: start_timer_on_button_press
description: When no other motion is pending, reads the fire-button bit of the joystick port status and, if it is pressed and a delay counter is clear, starts a 25-step timer and records a mode value. Otherwise it counts the delay counter down.

name: move_position_along_timer_path
description: While a timer is running, moves the object's position fields by a step chosen from a table and a direction flag. When the position leaves a fixed range, the motion stops, a flag is set and the timer is cleared.

name: advance_entry_phase_table
description: Advances five active entries through a short cycle, writing each one's value from a table plus an object offset. After four steps an entry either retires and adds 500 to a 32-bit accumulator, or switches to a delayed phase.

name: move_entries_along_grid_path
description: Updates active entries that move through the level grid, using a table-driven speed for each. Each entry either advances along a sequence of positions, or probes the grid cells around it to choose a direction state and moves within limits for that state.

name: move_entries_from_pointer_list
description: Moves entries in a counted list addressed through a pointer register, applying the same grid-path rules as the update routine. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: advance_alternating_phase_indices
description: Alternates between two countdown phases. When the second phase ends it reloads the first phase with 50 and advances a sequence index that wraps at seven and a state index that wraps at fifteen.

name: process_active_entries_in_turn
description: For each of five active entries, copies its two position words and a 32-bit value into a scratch record and then calls the next routine to process that record.

name: initialise_five_record_block
description: Sets a group of control words in an output structure to constant values, with some derived from the scratch position. It then fills five 32-bit records in a block with incrementing addresses and a fixed marker word.

name: fill_animated_grid_records
description: Resets several control words, advances a counter that wraps at 50 and another that wraps at four, then walks a 12-by-20 block of level grid cells. For each cell it writes five 32-bit records, shifting the animated cell codes by the counter.

name: fill_grid_block_records
description: Resets the same control words as the animated grid filler, then writes five 32-bit records for each cell of a 12-by-20 block without reading the grid values.

name: fill_grid_cell_records
description: Resets the same control words as the other grid fillers, then walks a 12-by-20 block of level grid cells and writes five 32-bit records for each cell, using the cell value to offset the record address.

name: fill_scrolling_block_records
description: Resets control words, writes two groups of four 32-bit records from a block chosen by a counter, and advances that counter, which wraps at seven.

name: update_animation_frame_records
description: Counts down a delay and steps a frame index that wraps at four, copying frame data into pointer records for two groups of entries. Those records are zeroed while a hide flag is set, and a second index then fills two more records from a table.

name: toggle_value_fill_five_records
description: Toggles between two stored 32-bit values and writes five records from the newly selected value at a fixed stride.

name: initialise_object_state
description: Clears most fields of an object structure and sets a group of counters and limits to constant values. It also writes four 32-bit starting positions and points one field at the global block.

name: reset_object_starting_state
description: Resets a subset of the same object fields to their starting constants, covering flags, counters and four 32-bit starting positions.

name: load_entry_records_from_table
description: Copies four entry records from a table selected by an index into the entry block. Each record receives the table fields and the object's 32-bit value, and its counters are zeroed.

name: reinitialise_entry_when_timer_expires
description: Decrements a countdown and, when it reaches zero, copies a fixed set of table words into a secondary entry record and clears its counters. The record's last word is then set to a constant.

name: load_five_entries_and_reset
description: Copies five entry records from a table selected by an index and zeroes their counters. It then resets the object's four 32-bit starting positions, its flags and a 500 limit counter.

name: call_then_set_control_value
description: Calls a routine and then writes the constant 256 into one control field of the object.

name: call_then_set_flagged_control
description: Calls a routine and then writes a different constant, with its high bit set, into the same control field.

name: reset_positions_and_call_next
description: Writes the same four 32-bit starting positions used by the object reset, then calls the routine that follows it.

name: decode_keyboard_key_code
description: Reads the keyboard serial register, converts the byte to a key code and looks up the matching character in a key table. It clears the stored key state when that character matches the previously stored one.

name: handle_keypress_actions
description: Reacts to the decoded key value: the letter p toggles a stored word once per press, the escape key clears one counter, and one other special key code clears a second counter. Releasing the key resets the press latch.

name: call_routine_seven_times
description: Calls the routine that follows it seven times in a row. It is a fixed repeat loop with no other work.

name: divide_value_ten_seven_times
description: Copies a 32-bit value into a scratch word, then seven times divides the scratch word by ten and calls the following routine after each division.

name: call_next_routine_once
description: Calls the routine that follows it once and returns, with no other work.

name: divide_counter_ten_twice
description: Copies a 16-bit counter into a scratch word, then divides it by ten twice, calling the following routine after each division.

name: divide_incremented_counter_twice
description: Adds one to a 16-bit field, copies the result into a scratch word and divides it by ten twice, calling the following routine after each division.

name: fill_five_records_from_args
description: Stores a 32-bit argument, resets a group of control words to constants, and writes five 32-bit records with a fixed marker word. The record addresses advance by a fixed stride.

name: save_disable_restore_chip_enables
description: Saves the current DMA and interrupt enable state, then clears the custom chip enable bits with several register writes and calls a series of setup routines. It then opens the graphics library by name and restores the saved DMA and interrupt bits with the set bit on, after one more control write.

name: decode_packed_rle_bitmap
description: Searches the input for the tag text BODY, then decodes run-length packed data into rows of 40 bytes. Literal runs are copied, repeat runs fill with one byte, and the code 128 is ignored; the output moves between blocks of rows as it goes.

name: repeat_wait_then_call_forever
description: Calls a fixed external routine 1000 times, then calls the following routine and starts the count again, so it never returns. The early exit inside the loop is never taken.

name: write_five_fixed_pointer_records
description: Writes five pointer-pair records into a fixed block, starting from a fixed address and advancing by a fixed stride each time.

name: convert_cmap_to_color_words
description: Searches the input for the tag text CMAP, then converts 32 three-byte color entries into 16-bit color words. Each word combines the first byte shifted up one nibble, the second byte, and the high nibble of the third byte, and the words are stored in a table with a four-byte stride.

name: copy_thirty_two_words_strided
description: Copies 32 16-bit words from the input into a table, writing each one with a four-byte stride. It is a plain block copy with no conversion.

name: rotate_word_ring_by_one
description: Rotates a ring of 16-bit words by one position: each word moves into the next slot and the first word is carried around to the last slot. The slots are spaced eight bytes apart.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: call_external_five_times
description: Resets a set of control words to constants, then five times calls a fixed external routine with two addresses. After each call the returned addresses are advanced by 10240 and 7680.

name: reset_and_call_external_five
description: Resets a similar set of control words and then makes the same five calls to a different fixed external routine, advancing the returned addresses by 10240 and 7680 each time.

name: call_then_set_control_value
description: Calls a routine and then writes the constant 256 into one control field of the object.

name: call_then_set_flagged_control
description: Calls a routine and then writes a different constant, with its high bit set, into the same control field.

name: wait_for_masked_field_value
description: Busy-waits until selected bits of a 32-bit word at a fixed offset from the address register equal a set value, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: install_vectors_and_enable_chips
description: Calls two function pointers taken from an argument structure, then writes jump instructions that point at other routines into fixed low-memory vectors. It sets DMA and interrupt enable bits through the custom chip registers and finishes with a trap call.

name: patch_code_locations_then_init
description: Overwrites several code locations with return, no-operation, jump and call instructions that point at other routines. It then sets a handful of state variables to constants and marks a one-time flag when it is still zero.

name: spin_if_bit_set
description: Checks one bit of a CIA interrupt-control byte and loops forever if it is set. Otherwise it sets a shared byte to a fixed constant and returns with its register arguments unchanged.

name: advance_cyclic_counter_table
description: Advances a small cyclic counter held in a shared byte, first storing the old value in a table entry and clearing the counter when that old value is even. Old values in a narrow range are replaced by their low bit, and the shared byte is then set to a fixed constant.

name: set_shared_byte_eight
description: Writes the constant 8 to a shared byte and returns. It does nothing else.

name: write_fixed_text_and_terminate
description: When a stored length is zero, sets it to five and writes the five-character text Angel into a buffer. It then writes a zero byte at the stored length position.

name: poll_prompt_until_accepted
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with a fixed address argument. When that call returns zero it makes three further calls with fixed arguments, then polls another routine until it returns a nonzero value.

name: poll_prompt_until_accepted
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with a fixed address argument. When that call returns zero it makes three further calls with fixed arguments, then polls another routine until it returns a nonzero value.

name: call_handler_then_reset_state
description: Calls a function pointer taken from an argument structure and stores its result. It then resets a group of state variables to constants and sets a one-time flag when that flag is still zero.

name: dispatch_then_reset_state
description: Calls a function pointer from an argument structure when a shared value is negative, otherwise calls the following routine. It then performs the same state reset and one-time flag step.

name: forward_to_stored_handler
description: Calls the function pointer at a fixed offset in a stored structure and returns the two data register values it was given.

name: call_stored_handler_reset_state
description: Calls a function pointer at a fixed offset in a stored structure. It then resets the same group of state variables and sets the one-time flag when it is still zero.

name: reset_state_and_mark_init
description: Sets a group of state variables to constants and sets a one-time flag when it is still zero. It performs no other work.

name: clear_byte_block_from_count
description: Zeroes a block of bytes starting at a fixed address, with the block length taken from a shared value.

name: fill_byte_block_with_one
description: Sets a block of bytes starting at a fixed address to one, with the block length taken from a shared value.

name: count_zero_and_nonzero_bytes
description: Counts the zero and nonzero bytes in a block that starts at a fixed address and is sized by a shared value. The two counts are stored in fields of the argument structure.

name: count_until_table_entry_nonzero
description: Increments a counter in the argument structure on each pass until the byte at an index, taken from a shared value and used against a fixed table, becomes nonzero.

name: clear_long_word_columns
description: Calls the following routine, then zeroes ten 32-bit words in each of four columns. The columns are spaced at fixed strides from a base address.

name: copy_long_word_columns
description: Calls two routines to obtain addresses, then copies ten 32-bit words in each of four columns from the first area to the second, using the same fixed strides.

name: delay_busy_loop
description: Runs a nested counting loop of fixed size to waste time. It has no other effect.

name: set_value_doubled_when_flagged
description: Stores a shared value into a 16-bit field of the structure, doubling it when the structure's first flag word is nonzero.

name: step_field_count_nonzero_results
description: Increments or decrements a 16-bit field according to a flag word. When a second counter is zero, it calls a routine and increments a third counter each time that routine returns a nonzero value.

name: run_timed_passes_until_flag
description: Runs several counted passes that each call a few routines, using half and full values of a shared count. It returns early as soon as a status word in the structure is nonzero, and it advances a counter in the structure between the passes.

name: mark_byte_values_in_table
description: Calls a routine, then runs seven groups. Each group walks a byte list backwards until a 255 terminator and sets the table entry for every listed value to one, then calls a routine.

name: clear_byte_values_in_table
description: Walks a byte list until a 255 terminator in each of six groups, setting the table entry for every listed value to zero, and calls a routine after each group.

name: store_shared_value_plus_one
description: Stores one more than a shared value into a 32-bit field of the structure.

name: call_and_store_three_words
description: Calls a routine three times and stores the same input word into three different 16-bit fields of the structure, one after each call.

name: store_doubled_value_plus_one
description: Stores an input word minus one into a 16-bit field, then stores a shared value and twice that value plus one into 32-bit fields of the structure.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: store_shared_block_address
description: Stores the address of a shared block into a pointer field of the structure.

name: run_counted_toggle_loop
description: Runs a loop counted down from an input word, toggling a state byte on each pass and calling several routines. It stops early when a shared flag becomes nonzero and returns the shared value.

name: reset_counter_and_pointer
description: Clears one field, increments a counter in the structure, and stores the address of a shared block into a pointer field. It calls three routines, clearing a second field between them.

name: blit_shifted_record_to_planes
description: Looks up an image record in a table by index and writes its rows into four bitplanes. Each row is shifted by a sub-byte amount, and each plane is updated by clearing the masked bits and then OR-ing in the shifted data.

name: clear_flag_and_call_two
description: Clears a shared byte and then calls two routines in sequence.

name: call_routine_span_times
description: Calls a routine once, then calls it again once for each step of a span computed from two input words. It clears a shared byte at the end.

name: set_flag_and_call_two
description: Sets a shared byte to one and then calls two routines in sequence. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: combine_table_masks_by_position
description: Calls a routine to obtain a position value, then looks up 16-bit mask entries in a fixed table using the low nibbles of two inputs. When the high parts of the two inputs match it combines the entries with AND and OR, otherwise it returns the individual entries.

name: store_shared_value_word
description: Stores a shared value into a 16-bit field of the structure and returns its two input registers unchanged.

name: stub_return_inputs_unchanged
description: Routine that does no work and returns its two input register values unchanged. It has no calls, memory access or hardware register use.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: draw_bit_pattern_across_planes
description: Writes a pattern into four bitplanes, choosing for each plane whether to set, clear or toggle bits according to a shared mask and a draw-mode flag. A wider variant applies the same pattern to a run of following words in each plane.

name: store_range_then_call_two
description: Stores two input values into shared words, then calls two routines when a flag is clear or when a comparison against a shared value falls within a range. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: store_parameter_to_shared_word
description: Stores its input word into a shared 16-bit variable and returns.

name: call_two_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls two routines in sequence and returns, with no other work.

name: set_pixel_bit_across_planes
description: Calls a routine to obtain a bit position, then sets or clears that bit in one byte of each of four bitplanes according to successive low bits of a shared value.

name: store_words_then_call_conditionally
description: Stores two input words into shared variables and calls routines in sequence, calling one more only when a register argument is zero. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: step_line_with_error_term
description: Takes absolute differences between two point pairs and steps along the longer axis with a Bresenham-style error term, calling a routine at each step and once more at the end. Found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: step_line_variant_negated_x
description: A variant of the line stepper that starts from the negated first difference, with the same error-term loop and per-step call. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: step_line_variant_negated_y
description: Another variant of the line stepper, starting from a negated second difference, with the same error-term loop and per-step call. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: step_error_term_until_done
description: Advances a Bresenham-style error term in a loop, calling a routine after each step, and returns once the step counter reaches zero. Its structure matches the inner stepping loop of the line routines, and it was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: finish_line_error_steps
description: Advances a Bresenham-style error term through the remaining line steps, calling a routine between steps and once more at the end. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: finish_line_error_steps
description: Advances a Bresenham-style error term through the remaining line steps, calling a routine between steps and once more at the end. It was found in a gap between known routines, so its use is unconfirmed.

name: test_coordinates_inside_range
description: When a flag in the structure is set, orders two coordinate pairs into ranges and tests a shared value against them. The result is not stored, so the routine has no visible effect.

name: blit_masked_block_four_planes
description: Draws a rectangle of words into four bitplanes, combining each word with a background source through a mask. When a shift argument is nonzero the first column is handled separately before the remaining columns are copied.

name: clear_block_by_longwords
description: Zeroes 32000 bytes starting at a shared pointer, written as groups of four 32-bit words.

name: copy_shared_block_in_place
description: Copies 32000 bytes of a shared block in groups of four 32-bit words. Both pointers are set to the same address in either branch, so the copy leaves the data unchanged.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: copy_bitplane_rows_four_planes
description: Copies twenty bytes from each of 160 rows, in all four bitplanes, from a source area to a destination area with a row stride of forty bytes. When a shared flag is set it also calls a routine for each row and once more at the end.

name: forward_call_and_return
description: Calls the routine that follows it and then returns. It adds no work of its own.

name: halt_in_infinite_loop
description: Loops forever with no exit, so the program never gets past this routine once it is reached. It performs no other work.

name: store_shifted_then_wait
description: Stores its input word shifted left by four bits into a shared word. It then busy-waits while that shifted input is nonzero, so it returns only when the shifted value is zero.

name: check_small_inputs_call_external
description: When a shared flag is set, checks two input values against eight. For each value below eight it calls a fixed external routine with the argument 1024, then calls the following routine.

name: set_shared_pointer_by_flag
description: Stores the address of a shared variable into a pointer slot, and replaces it with a fixed address when a flag is zero. It returns its input byte unchanged.

name: set_shared_pointer_by_flag
description: Stores the address of a shared variable into a pointer slot, and replaces it with a fixed address when a flag is zero. It returns its input byte unchanged.

name: set_shared_pointer_by_flag
description: Stores the address of a shared variable into a pointer slot, and replaces it with a fixed address when a flag is zero. It returns its input byte unchanged.

name: set_shared_pointer_by_flag
description: Stores the address of a shared variable into a pointer slot and replaces it with a fixed address when a flag is zero. It performs no other work.

name: copy_table_twice_set_bytes
description: Copies twelve words from a table chosen by a shared index into a block, writing each word twice at a four-byte stride. It then stores three computed byte values, one of them a flag bit taken from a shared value.

name: set_two_shared_flags_on
description: Sets two shared flag bytes to one and returns. It performs no other work.

name: clear_shared_flag_byte
description: Sets one shared flag byte to zero and returns. It performs no other work.

name: update_value_when_changed
description: When the input differs from a stored value, stores the input and derives another shared value as the input times eight plus 140. Nothing changes when the input is equal to the stored value.

name: update_bounded_position_return_code
description: Updates shared position values, clamping them to fixed limits, and returns a numeric code. The code depends on whether the values lie inside a fixed window, on how they moved relative to a stored value, and on a few special cases.

name: set_bit_then_bad_instruction
description: Sets one bit of a shared byte and increments a counter, then writes an OR into a byte before the bytes stop decoding as valid instructions. It is bad data after the first few steps, so it is not a finished routine.

name: walk_packed_step_table
description: Walks a table of packed step bytes, adding signed x and y deltas taken from each byte to a position. It calls a check routine at each step and stops at a zero byte, when the check reports a hit, or when the table index reaches its limit.

name: poll_until_nonzero_count
description: Calls a routine up to the count given in its argument, calling a second routine after each miss. It returns the first nonzero result, or zero when the count runs out.

name: initialise_tables_and_setup_paths
description: Fills a 256-entry identity table, sets several shared values to constants, and runs a long sequence of setup calls with fixed data addresses. It then branches on a shared value and takes one of two setup paths that call the same family of routines.

name: examine_timed_out_segment_entry
description: The decompiler timed out, so no pseudo-code is available and the behaviour is not recovered. The routine has 23 instructions, was executed in the reference run, and was entered from outside the static flow; no calls, text or hardware registers are listed.

name: forward_call_with_zero_flag
description: Passes its four arguments on to the following routine with a fifth argument of zero, then returns.

name: forward_call_with_zero_fourth
description: Passes its three arguments on to the following routine with a fourth argument of zero, then returns.

name: print_word_wrapped_text
description: Prints a null-terminated string one character at a time, breaking lines at spaces so that each line fits a width taken from a shared table. It emits line feeds at the breaks and at the end of each wrapped line, and stops at the end of the string.

name: convert_lowercase_to_uppercase
description: Converts a lowercase ASCII letter to uppercase by subtracting 32. Any other byte is returned unchanged.

name: convert_uppercase_to_lowercase
description: Converts an uppercase ASCII letter to lowercase by adding 32. Any other character is returned unchanged.

name: read_byte_field_offset
description: Returns the byte at a fixed offset in the structure pointed to by the address register. It performs no other work.

name: clear_shared_flag_then_call
description: Clears a shared variable and then calls one fixed routine. It performs no other work.

name: layout_seven_centered_rows
description: Calls setup routines, then for seven entries calls a routine with a horizontal position centred on a width of 320 using a table value. Between entries it advances a vertical offset by a second table value.

name: wait_until_nonzero_then_store
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with an address until it returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It then passes that value to a third routine, stores it in a shared variable and returns it.

name: wait_until_nonzero_then_pass
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with an address until it returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It then passes a shared variable to a third routine and returns the result it has in its return register.

name: pass_shared_value_return_field
description: Passes a shared variable to a fixed routine and returns a 32-bit field read from the structure pointed to by the address register.

name: wait_until_nonzero_then_pass
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with an address until it returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It then passes a shared variable to a third routine and returns the nonzero value.

name: wait_until_nonzero_then_pass
description: Repeatedly calls a fixed routine with an address until it returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It then passes a shared variable to a third routine and returns the nonzero value.

name: pass_shared_value_return_field
description: Passes a shared variable to a fixed routine and returns a 32-bit field read from the structure pointed to by the address register.

name: wait_then_call_with_result
description: Calls a routine with its first argument, then waits until a fixed routine returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It passes that value and the second and third arguments to a third routine, and returns 1.

name: pass_two_fields_return_one
description: Passes two 32-bit fields of the structure pointed to by the address register to a fixed routine and returns 1.

name: forward_call_with_fixed_block
description: Calls the following routine with a fixed block address, zeros for three arguments and its own first argument, then returns.

name: call_chain_with_shared_value
description: Calls a routine with its argument, takes a value from a second routine and converts it through a third. It then passes the converted value, that value and a shared variable to a fourth routine.

name: call_chain_return_result
description: Calls a routine with its argument, then runs a chain of further calls using the returned value and a shared variable. It finishes by calling another routine with those results and returns the value produced by the chain.

name: store_call_result_in_slot
description: Calls a routine with its first argument, takes the returned value from a second routine and stores it in a 32-bit slot of a shared table selected by the second argument.

name: call_two_routines_with_argument
description: Calls a routine with its argument and then calls a second routine, returning no value. It performs no other work.

name: store_argument_in_shared_word
description: Stores its 16-bit argument into a shared variable and returns. It performs no other work.

name: wait_then_store_with_default
description: Calls a routine, then waits until a fixed routine returns a nonzero value. It substitutes 65535 for a zero third argument, passes the arguments and a shared variable to another routine, and returns the second argument.

name: wait_then_store_default_pair
description: Calls a routine, then waits until a fixed routine returns a nonzero value, calling a second routine between tries. It substitutes 65535 for a zero third argument, then passes the shared variable and the arguments to two further routines.

name: default_zero_field_then_call
description: Sets a 32-bit field of the structure to 65535 when it is zero, then passes that field, a shared variable and three structure fields to a fixed routine. It has no return value.

name: return_flag_from_wait_result
description: Calls a routine with its argument, then returns 1 when a fixed routine returns a nonzero value and 0 otherwise.

name: wait_convert_store_shared
description: Calls a fixed routine with a data address, then waits until another fixed routine returns a nonzero value, calling a third routine between tries. It converts that value into a shared variable, passes it to a further routine and returns it.

name: convert_field_store_shared
description: Converts a 32-bit field of the structure through a fixed routine, stores the result in a shared variable, then calls another routine and passes the shared variable to a fixed routine. It returns the shared value.

name: stub_return_only
description: Routine consisting only of a return, with no calls, memory access or hardware register use. It has one instruction and performs no work.

name: examine_timed_out_five_calls
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour is not recovered. The routine has 40 instructions, was executed in the reference run, and makes five calls to unnamed routines.

name: examine_timed_out_single_call
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour is not recovered. The routine has five instructions and one call to an unnamed routine, and was found in a gap between known routines.

name: examine_timed_out_short_entry
description: No pseudo-code was produced because the decompiler timed out, so the behaviour is not recovered. The routine has three instructions and was found in a gap between known routines, with one caller.

name: reset_state_by_switch
description: Sets a shared state variable to 10 for four of its values, and calls a routine for two of those values as well. Any other value leaves the state unchanged.

name: call_routine_fixed_arguments
description: Calls a routine with a fixed data address and shared values along with two constants, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: init_five_slot_block_defaults
description: Calls three fixed routines with a fixed data address and then clears two bytes and sets a third byte to 15 in each of five eight-byte slots.

name: call_fixed_routine_with_address
description: Calls a fixed routine with a fixed data address, then returns. It performs no other work.

name: call_fixed_routine_once
description: Calls one fixed routine with no arguments and returns. It performs no other work.

name: repeat_call_sequence_forever
description: Repeats forever a fixed sequence of calls: one with zero, a hundred calls with a counter, and one with 289 as its value. It never returns.

name: repeat_call_sequence_forever
description: Repeats forever a fixed sequence of calls: one with 289, one with zero, and a hundred calls with a counter. It never returns.
